statement: ControllerInterface RunTasks is serialized by a pending report-handler gate: periodic status, LED ACK, reporting mode 0x37 ACK, EEPROM accelerometer calibration read at 0x0016, IR enable/sensitivity/mode, speaker mute and disable ACKs, then extension and MotionPlus identity/mode tasks. Nonzero error ACK or missing reply can cause retry of the same unsatisfied prerequisite. Report handlers expire after 5 seconds, with read errors forwarded as empty results and readiness flags left unset.
